notes.title: Update 1.17 (7/16/2020)
notes.content:
Controller vibration added when shooting weapon
Adjusted slime sprites
Increase bullet speed on advanced enemies
Controller vibration increased on taking damage
Grenade launcher explodes on ricochet
Grenade launcher does 75% damage to plasma shielded enemies
Grenade launcher defaults to 15 ammo
Grenade launcher has quicker reload time
Cryoblaster damage has been increased

notes.title: Update 1.16 (7/12/2020)
notes.content:
Fixed issue with sprite not animating correctly on second controller layout

Added Boss images in confronting dialogue scenes

Added weighted probability when initializing random stats

Color adjustments for Level 1 and 2

Fixed issue with sight not showing correct direction under specific settings

Alt+enter will now bring the game to full screen

Fixed issue with door prompts duplicating

notes.title: Update 1.15 (6/11/2020)
notes.content:
Added shadows under character and enemy sprites

Added a Second controller layout
        Located under Options -> Settings -> Controls -> Layout
        This new layout will allow special abilities to be used from the D-pad

Can now skip the first cutscene when starting a new game

Settings will now save and load properly when loading a save game file

notes.title: HOTFIX (5/8/2020)
notes.content:
Fixed issue with save files not being created

Fixed issue with game breaking if not online through Steam

notes.title: Small Patch (4/20/2020)
notes.content:
Fixed issue with exception being thrown at save

Fixed lighting environment when attacking with sword on lower resolutions

Fixed issue with cutscenes still appearing after leaving to go back to the hub

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
Enemies will now drop ammo boxes for you to pick up.
Ammo boxes contain ammo for the shotgun, revolvers, grenade launcher, and the auto-blaster.

Shotgun, revolvers, grenade launcher, and the auto-blaster have increased damage

Starting pistol damage has been slightly reduced.

Fixed building block on level 8 stopping bullets

notes.title: LAUNCH HOTFIX (3/28/2020)
notes.content:
Fixed Black Cat achievement not spawning

Added 3 more achievements!
